en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is to acquaint students with the basic issues in the field of service, maintenance, diagnostics and repair of machines and equipment used in the area of viticulture, so that they are able to ensure their operability or use the range of services.
